heading: May we use cookies?
text: We only use cookies that aren’t necessary if you say yes. You can change your choice at the bottom of any page.
necessaryText: Keep the site working and remember your choice. These can’t be turned off.
preferencesText: Remember your settings on the site.
statisticsText: Show how many people visit and what they read.
marketingText: Show whether ads bring people to the site.
targetingText: Use your visit to show you ads elsewhere.
